FedPolicyB.comparison_rule: Compare the target announced at the period-ending scheduled meeting with the target in place on the day after the preceding scheduled meeting; this includes cumulative inter-meeting changes.
FedPolicyB.target_definition: Federal-funds target rate; use the midpoint if the FOMC specifies an interval.
FedPolicyB.notes: The IEM prospectus states that FedPolicyB replaced FedPolicy and that the markets differ in treatment of inter-meeting changes and trader access. This general rule does not validate individual family mappings or split notices.

FedPolicy.notes: Do not apply the FedPolicyB cumulative-change rule to Market 20. The surviving FedPolicyB prospectus explicitly says the earlier market used different inter-meeting treatment, but it does not state the earlier rule.

pilot.payoff_summary: Each contract pays USD 1 when the target rate on the meeting date is, respectively, lower, unchanged or higher than on the comparison date, and USD 0 otherwise.
pilot.score_units: 100 times (up probability minus down probability), in probability points
pilot.notes: The prospectus explicitly names this initial family and both comparison dates. This check does not validate other families or the daily price/volume fields.

diagnostic_screen.purpose: Diagnostic only. Passing this screen does not authorize econometrics.
diagnostic_screen.meeting_day_rule: Exclude the whole meeting date and all later dates because the input has no intraday trade timestamps.
diagnostic_screen.refresh_rule: Only positive reported quantity refreshes the diagnostic trade price; a changed price on a zero-quantity row is separately flagged as unresolved.
